scenarios.title: Inner-loop workspace pressure
scenarios.primary_tax: compile-rebuild-edit-loop friction in a multi-crate workspace

environment.ci: shared CI plus local editor/cargo usage

must_prove: which rebuild or wait tax was exercised
what evidence source was imported or recorded
which operator or developer decision improved
skip_conditions: skip when the pilot is purely release-boundary or recommendation-only
skip when the seam does not touch active development loops

scenarios.title: Public-library release boundary
scenarios.primary_tax: release, semver, docs, and upgrade uncertainty around published library surfaces

topology.workspace_shape: publishable library or small library family

must_prove: what boundary was treated as public
which compatibility or migration decision was exercised
which docs or semantic imports were authoritative
skip_conditions: skip when the pilot does not touch publishable surfaces or upgrade questions

scenarios.title: Locked-down intake and policy lane
scenarios.primary_tax: package ingress, extraction, route authority, and policy review before use

topology.workspace_shape: consumer workspace with explicit package intake controls

must_prove: what source or route supplied bytes
what staging or extraction assumptions applied
skip_conditions: skip when the pilot begins after ingress or only reasons about built artifacts

scenarios.title: Native-edge polyglot boundary
scenarios.primary_tax: Rust/native boundary review with provider, linker, host-target, and foreign-build handoff complexity

topology.workspace_shape: polyglot workspace with foreign build components

channels: stable and nightly only where substrate requires it

must_prove: what Rust/native boundary was under review
what provider/link and host-vs-target posture applied
which consumer decision became safer or more auditable
skip_conditions: skip when the pilot never crosses a foreign build, ABI, provider, or linker boundary

scenarios.title: Cross-target docs and consumer drift
scenarios.primary_tax: claims drift when docs, targets, or downstream consumer slices assume the wrong environment

host_targets: at least one local target when relevant

must_prove: what target or docs assumptions were imported
which consumer slice remained lossy and why
which conclusions stayed prohibited until escalation
skip_conditions: skip when the pilot does not depend on docs-derived, semantic, or routed-consumer views
